question: Choose the most appropriate antonym for the word "harbinger" as used in the last line of the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. follower.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"harbinger"** means:

 
 
• A person or thing that announces or signals the approach of another; a forerunner. (अग्रदूत, पूर्वसूचक)
 
 
 
• The antonym of "harbinger" is **"follower"**, which means a person who comes after, especially as a successor or imitator. (अनुगामी, अनुयायी)
 
• **Example from the passage:** The blooming flowers were the harbinger of spring.
 
 
• **Example:** He was not a leader but a follower, always content to let others take the initiative.
 
 

Therefore, the antonym of “harbinger” is: **follower**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Catalyst** (प्रेरक): A person or thing that precipitates an event or change.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy acted as a catalyst for economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Precursor** (पूर्वगामी): A person or thing that comes before another of the same kind.
 
 
• **Example:** The flip phone was a precursor to the modern smartphone.
 
 
 
• **Trailblazer** (अग्रणी): A person who makes a new track through wild country; a pioneer.
 
 
• **Example:** She was a trailblazer in the field of genetic research.
